subject: Pilot extension and surge protection — pricing options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Cheng <laura@stably.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension and surge protection — initial usage summary

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really appreciate how quickly your engineering team integrated the SDK. I pulled a short usage summary from the pilot (attached) so we can align on the ask you mentioned: more runway to finish the model comparisons and a safety-net for short bursts next month.

Two asks from your side I took away:
- 2–4 week extension to the current time-boxed pilot (same hardware profile)
- a surge protection policy so you don’t hit throttling during load tests in week 2

High-level options we can offer:
A) Time extension only (no extra credits) — simple amend to the pilot dates
B) Credit bundle (token/compute credits) — you get headroom for bursts, expires 60 days after issuance
C) Hybrid: shortened extension + surge protection bucket (reserved burst capacity)

I added the usage report for transparency. If you’re leaning one way I can get a short quote over — Ben can include an explicit safety-net SLA and the pricing for the reserve bucket.

Next step: which option should I price formally? If B or C, do you want the bucket to be refundable/unconsumed?

Best,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_usage_report.pdf (summary, 4 pages)

From: Laura Cheng <laura@stably.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wei <tom.wei@novomed.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and surge protection — initial usage summary

Marissa — thanks for the quick summary and the file. A few clarifying points from our procurement and ML lead:

- Procurement prefers credit bundles (option B) because we can track consumption against budget rather than signing a formal date amendment.
- The burst windows are short (max 2–6 hours), but frequency could be up to 3x/week during load testing. We want assurances that the burst won’t be throttled or queued behind other customers.
- Can the credits be time-limited (we prefer 90 days) and transferable within our org (yes)?

If you can send two quotes (credits-only and hybrid with a small time extension + reserved bucket) we’ll circulate with finance and legal. We’re targeting a PO by 11 Aug if pricing is aligned.

–Laura

Laura Cheng
Head of ML Engineering | Stably Health
laura@stably.ai | +1 617-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Cheng <laura@stably.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and surge protection — initial usage summary

Laura — thanks, this is helpful. I put together two concrete sketches (attached spreadsheet) and a recommended safety-net configuration: 

Option 1 — Credits-only (preferred for procurement):
- 100k token-equivalent credits (good for compute + generation)
- Credits valid for 90 days from issuance
- Credits transferable across sub-orgs within Stably (account-level grant)
- No SLA on latency beyond standard trial tenancy; credits only increase your consumption budget
- Cost: $9,750 (list) — we can offer a 10% transaction discount at PO stage

Option 2 — Hybrid timebox + reserved surge bucket (recommended for load testing):
- 2-week extension of current pilot window
- Reserved surge bucket: 6 hours/day reserved capacity for 2 weeks (pre-warmed GPUs), 100k token cap
- Safety-net: guaranteed immediate capacity up to the reserved bucket; overages billed at reduced surge rate (50% of on-demand)
- Cost for reserve + extension: $18,500 (list) — can offer a first-month 20% concession for new customers if you commit to a short follow-on SOW

We can also make the reserved bucket refundable on a pro-rata basis if under 25% consumed (one-time credit back). That addresses the "unused" concern.

Attached: modular_pricing_v2.xlsx (detailed line items, surge bucket assumptions).

If procurement is running to 11 Aug, I recommend we lock Option 1 with the 10% transaction discount to keep the PO clean; then add the reserve bucket as an addendum if you decide to run concentrated load windows.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through the numbers tomorrow.

—Ben

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 202-555-0145

My notes / ask:
- Approve the 20% concession on the hybrid option if we require a one-month follow-on commit (this is a standard small-risk incentive for pilot-to-SOW conversion).
- Approve refundable clause on reserved bucket when under 25% consumed — finance OK with this as a limited concession for strategic logos.
- If we want to expedite the PO, offer Option 1 with the 10% transaction discount and include Option 2 as an addendum.

Marissa — can you confirm we have authority to sign small addenda (<$25k) for pilot amendments? If not, I’ll escalate to Sales Ops for the sign-off.

Thanks,
Soojin

Laura — we’ve provisionally reserved the hybrid surge bucket and will issue the 100k credit bundle if you prefer credits-only. Can you confirm which PO path you want by EOD Monday (04 Aug)? If you choose hybrid, I’ll attach the refundable clause and the 20% first-month concession in the addendum.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live for load tests.

Best,
Marissa
